evidence.observation: Only the exact scoped/unscoped relative link forms or canonical absolute form are eligible; raw text is checked before any normalization, and physical parents/destination are acquired without following the link.
Nofollow descriptor walks, generation checks, strict UTF-8 roundtrip, byte caps, cleanup and revalidation bind the physical premise.
Future raw canceled-component/invalid-byte and mutation controls are explicit.

documentaryCounterexample.input: node_modules/demo -> ../missing/../packages/demo, or an intervening canceled regular-file/symlink component
documentaryCounterexample.analysis: Section 4 line 51 explicitly refuses these raw spellings even if normalization lands on a registered workspace; no canonical-body proof can be authorized through this link. The permitted ../ or ../../ prefixes only ascend the already acquired regular root/node_modules/scope parents.

evidence.observation: Exact builtin guard, canonical importer, valid bare grammar, nearest scope/self-reference refusal, mode-specific bounded ancestry, exports-first CJS precedence, sibling-file refusal, stop at nearer unsupported candidate and premise revalidation are specified.
Node checks self first and then searches for the package directory, not merely an existing package manifest.
CJS exports lookup precedes file/extension and directory legacy lookup.
POSIX ancestor search suppresses the redundant node_modules component.

documentaryCounterexample.input: A nested regular package scope named demo exports inner.mjs while the registered outer demo workspace link exports outer.mjs. Also consider a nearer manifestless package directory or CJS sibling file.
documentaryCounterexample.analysis: Matching nearest self-reference is UNKNOWN_SELF_REFERENCE before outer lookup; nearer manifestless/unsupported candidates stop with UNKNOWN. CJS file candidates without exports refuse rather than manufacture a directory proof. This is an intentionally conservative subset, not a claim to implement every native legacy route.

evidence.observation: Closed ASCII targets reject normalization-sensitive strings; explicit new URL plus fileURLToPath and physical owner-prefix mapping precede acquisition. Exports never retries extensions, main or index in either mode.
Native exports constructs a URL and enforces the package URL prefix.
CJS exports converts the URL and checks that exact file.
Paired URL-sensitive and exact-versus-extensionless controls are required.

documentaryCounterexample.input: Selected export ./sa\tfe.mjs with a decoded tab, with both tab-named and ordinary files; or an absent extensionless exports target with only target.js present.
documentaryCounterexample.analysis: The raw tab is outside the positive grammar and is not normalized into another body. An absent exact exports target does not acquire target.js. Roots containing valid spaces/Unicode are handled separately by the required URL roundtrip.

evidence.observation: Oracle yields URL/path only; distinct filenames discriminate branches, with separate static derivation for shared-target branches.

documentaryCounterexample.input: Two active/default branches share the same target URL.
documentaryCounterexample.analysis: Equal native URLs are explicitly insufficient to claim observation of the chosen branch; line 97 requires a separate static derivation.
